name: blab-translation
description: 叭叭翻译 — AI 驱动的 Chrome 智能翻译插件

scripts.build: echo 'No build required - load directly in Chrome'
scripts.zip: V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && rm -f blab-translation-$V.zip && zip -r blab-translation-$V.zip manifest.json _locales/ background/ content/ i18n/ offscreen/ onboarding/ options/ popup/ pdf/ shared/ vendor/ icons/icon16.png icons/icon32.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npx playwright test
